page.layout: One page of text: a heading INDEX at top centre, then a heading Tractatus II., then a printed table of contents in one column with page numbers at the right; no margin notes.
page.notes: The last entry, number 17, has no printed page number visible beside it, so it is given as printed with the number only. Some ligatures and long-s forms were modernised to plain letters in the transcription; the Latin "Tractatus II." heading is the only division heading. Faint printed marks at the lower right corner are a digitiser's watermark and are omitted.
